name: Portfolio Heat & Factor Cap
known_limitations: Lite has no portfolio snapshot or heat methodology runtime.
notes: Legacy six-gates-production-v1 is selected active V1; this Lite artifact is review-required knowledge only. Unresolved exact cap/methodology configuration, missing/invalid portfolio equity, or missing risk/allocation input => INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

details.purpose: Protect projected portfolio heat, single-stock allocation and sector allocation.

pass_condition.description: Projected heat <= 0.06, candidate stock allocation <= 0.25, and sector allocation <= 0.35 under portfolio-structural-risk-heat-v1.

fail_condition.description: Any of projected heat > 0.06, stock allocation > 0.25, or sector allocation > 0.35.

details.score_interaction: Hard portfolio constraint independent of analytical score; no score/LLM override.
details.strategy_interaction: Cannot size, allocate, or place an order.
details.portfolio_context: Requires portfolio equity, existing/candidate risk amounts, candidate allocation and sector allocation from a compatible snapshot.
known_limitations: Lite has no portfolio snapshot or heat methodology runtime.
